name: Single Unders
instructions: Hold a jump rope with both hands, positioning the rope behind your feet.
Stand with feet together and elbows close to your sides.
Swing the rope over your head using wrist rotation.
Jump just high enough for the rope to pass under your feet once.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent.
Keep your jumps low and quick, maintaining a steady rhythm.
Keep your core engaged and maintain an upright posture.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
